mentions.name: Navigation API (virtualstate/navigation)
mentions.description: An implementation of the web Navigation API for Node, Bun, Deno, and as a browser polyfill, providing async state navigations. It has 90% test coverage, uses web platform tests to verify compatibility, is already in use by some larger companies, and targets the Navigation API that is soon to become a baseline in evergreen browsers (with React recently adding Navigation API support for the browser reload indicator).
